seed-article-2.e: Awuqinisekile ukuthi ungakhetha kanjani umhlinzeki wewebhusayithi? Sebenzisa lesi siqondiso esilula ukuze uqhathanise, ubuze imibuzo efanele futhi uqinisekise ukuthi umphumela ufanele izidingo zebhizinisi lakho.

Iwebhusayithi iwubambiswano lwesikhathi eside. Umhlinzeki ophendula ngokushesha, achaza izinto ngolimi olulula futhi athembeke ngesikhathi nezindleko wuhlala emnandi kakhulu ukusebenza naye.
Uyafuna ukwazi ukuthi sisebenza kanjani? Ukubonisana mahhala ku-WhatsApp, noma nini lapho ukudinga.

seed-article-3.e: Amanani wamawebhusayithi angahluka kakhulu kuye ngezidingo zakho. Qonda izingxenye zezindleko ukuze uqhathanise izicelo zamanani ngokuzethemba okukhulu.

Iwebhusayithi yekhasi elilodwa yephrofayili yebhizinisi ilula ngokwemvelo kunesitolo se-inthanethi esinekalishi lokuthenga nemibiko. Izici namakhasi amaningi kudinga umsebenzi omningi.

Iwebhusayithi elula noma uhlelo oluphelele?

Kubhizinisi eliqala nje, iwebhusayithi yephrofayili enenkinobho ye-WhatsApp ivame ukwanela. Uhlelo oluphelele kakhulu, olufana nokulandelela isitoko, ukubhalisa nge-inthanethi noma ukuzenzakalela, lunengqondo uma umsebenzi wesandla uqala ukuqongelela.

Umbiko wokuthengisa wansuku zonke wenziwa futhi uthunyelwe ngokuzenzakalelayo njalo ebusuku.

Ibhizinisi lakho lidinga ukuzenzakalela nini?
Izimpawu zivame ukuzizwakalisa:
Isikhathi esiningi sichithwa ekuhambiseni idatha isuka kwenye indawo iye kwenye.
Kuvame ukuba namaphutha okurekhoda noma ama-oda aphuthiwe.

Qala ngomsebenzi owodwa othatha isikhathi esiningi

Zenzakalele okuphindaphindayo, ukuze isikhathi sakho siye kulokho okudinga ngempela isinqumo somuntu.
Unomsebenzi ophindaphindwayo ofuna ukuwulula? Sitshele, ukubonisana kungamahhala noma nini.

b: Abantu abaningi bacabanga ukuthi iwebhusayithi iphelele ngesikhathi esiyethulayo. Eqinisweni, njengesitolo esibonakalayo, iwebhusayithi idinga ukunakekelwa ukuze ihlale imnandi ukuyivakashela futhi ethembekile.
Yini okufanele uyihlole njalo
**Ulwazi lwebhizinisi.** Qinisekisa ukuthi ikheli, amahora okuvula, amanani nezinombolo zocingo kusalungile.
**Isivinini.** Hlola ukuthi iwebhusayithi isasheshe ukuvuleka yini, ikakhulukazi ngemuva kokwengeza izithombe.
**Amalinki namafomu.** Zama zonke izinkinobho, amalinki nefomu loxhumana nathi.
**Ukuphepha.** Buyekeza isofthiwe futhi uhlole amalungelo okufinyelela.
**Amakhophi okugcina.** Qinisekisa ukuthi kunekhophi engabuyiselwa uma kukhona okungahambi kahle.
**Ukuphelelwa kwedomeyini ne-hosting.** Ungavumeli kuphele ngaphandle kokuqaphela.
Ikhodi yohlelo lwe-Python esikrinini
Izibuyekezo ezincane, ezivamile zivimbela izinkinga ezinkulu.
Kaningi kangakanani?
Ukuhlolwa okulula kanye ngenyanga kwanele. Izibuyekezo zokuphepha namakhophi okugcina edatha kufanele ziqhutshwe njalo futhi ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Wonke amaphakheji e-Nocoding asehlanganisa unyaka o-1 wokulungiswa mahhala, ngakho ukunakekelwa okuyisisekelo akuyona into okufanele uyicabangele wena.
Ufuna iwebhusayithi yakho ihlale inakekelwe kahle? Ukubonisana mahhala noma nini.
